result.note: Tested the Agni-1 launch site, missile class, range and command, a classic Prelims defence target; the Suryastra flag-off is used as context.

questions.prompt: In May 2026, India test-launched the nuclear-capable Agni-1 missile. Consider the following statements about it:
items: It was launched from Chandipur, Odisha, under the Strategic Forces Command.
It is an intermediate-range ballistic missile.
It has a range of 700–1,200 km.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: Statement 2 is wrong because the story describes the Agni-1 as a short-range ballistic missile, not an intermediate-range one. In the same week, Defence Minister Rajnath Singh flagged off Suryastra, India's first 300 km Universal Rocket Launching System.
questions.source: India successfully test-launched the nuclear-capable Agni-1 short-range ballistic missile from Chandipur, Odisha on Thursday, validating all operational parameters under the Strategic Forces Command.
